verdict.rationale: Open WebUI ships its own built-in interactive FastAPI Swagger UI at /docs on a self-hosted instance, so an interactive API reference exists. It is available only when ENV=dev is set, the reference is labeled experimental, and there is no vendor-hosted playground or public OpenAPI spec (probes for openapi.json all returned 404). missing for 10: an interactive reference available without dev mode, explicitly documented runnable examples or try-it requests, a hosted playground or public OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Make sure to set the `ENV` environment variable to `dev` in order to access the Swagger documentation
the built-in interactive Swagger UI on the integrator's own instance, available only with ENV=dev
